about: [O1b] The streets' new things go over (brief §2: everything that can break registered with lane O6's set, and over when a car takes it): the Docks start, E into the coupe, west along Dock Rd and up onto its north pavement through the crates, barrels and drums by the loading doors, by the keys (tools/lib/o6_smash.mjs drive on a path): each goes over (out of its merge, drawn on its own), the car never inside a standing thing, nothing floating, everything resting. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o1b_smash.json

steps.label: along Dock Rd's pavement: the crates and the barrels go over, nothing passed through, nothing floating
